I see a dirty working tree already, including `cmd/entire/cli/strategy/push_v2.go`; I’m treating that as existing work and only reading around the failing test plus the global registry it touches.

The failing subtest is doing runtime registration inside a `t.Parallel()` subtest, so the first suspect is process-global agent registry interference. I’m checking for any other tests that mutate the same registry or cached registry-derived state while this package runs.

Nothing else in `strategy` appears to overwrite the whole registry, and the two other dynamic registrations are in non-parallel tests. I’m going to reproduce the package run with verbose output around the failing subtest so we can see the actual error, not just the tail.

content.text: Reproduced it. The dynamic lookup is resolving an agent with `Type() == "Kiro"` but `Name() == "kiro"`, so the issue is not “missing registration”; it’s a collision: another runtime-discovered/registered Kiro agent is already in the global registry.

The source of `Name() == "kiro"` is the real external agent binary at `/Users/ninawork/.local/bin/entire-agent-kiro`. The likely path is: a summary-provider test enables external discovery, discovery scans the real PATH as well as its temp fixture, then the rewind test gets a global registry containing two agents with `Type() == "Kiro"`.

Diagnosed, no code changed and nothing pushed.

The flake is a global agent registry collision, made environment-dependent by your real PATH.

`TestResolveAgentForRewind/dynamically_registered_agent_resolves_by_type` registers a fake agent with:

[rewind_test.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/rewind_test.go:249)
`Name() == "test-external-kiro"`, `Type() == "Kiro"`

But an earlier strategy test, `TestBuildSummaryGenerator_ExternalProvider`, enables external discovery and preserves the host PATH:

[manual_commit_condensation_test.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_condensation_test.go:151)

That discovery finds your real `/Users/ninawork/.local/bin/entire-agent-kiro`, whose `info` reports `name:"kiro"` and `type:"Kiro"`. Since `ResolveAgentForRewind` just calls `agent.GetByAgentType`, and `GetByAgentType` linearly scans a Go map, it can return either `"kiro"` or `"test-external-kiro"` for the same type:

[registry.go](/Users/ninawork/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent/registry.go:204)

That matches the reproduced failure:

```text
rewind_test.go:267: Name() = "kiro", want "test-external-kiro"
```

Verification:
- `TestResolveAgentForRewind` alone passed `-count=100`.
- Full strategy package reproduced the failure.
- Minimal combo `TestBuildSummaryGenerator_ExternalProvider|TestResolveAgentForRewind` reproduced it intermittently.
- Same minimal combo with `~/.local/bin` removed from PATH passed `-count=20`.

Likely fix direction: isolate/restore the global agent registry around the external-summary test, or make the rewind test use a fake type that cannot collide with real external agents.
